brief: Holds a list of sentences or documents and selects among them by meaning: closest to a query, ranked for a query, or by sentiment.
detail: A list of texts is a list of strings that carries meaning, so it inherits everything of stzStringList (Content, NthString, Joined, ThatContain, Longest) and adds the natural layer. Build one with new stzListOfTexts(aList) or StzListOfTextsQ(aList); the sentence splitters of stzText answer a plain stzList, so wrap their result. Without a neural model the meaning methods fall back to word overlap, and the sentiment scorer reads English only; a model loaded through StzNeuralModelQ upgrades the similarity and ranking.
receiver: o1 = new stzListOfTexts([ "The cat sat on the mat.", "I love this wonderful sunny day!", "This is terrible and I hate it." ])
example: #--> The cat sat on the mat.
#--> I love this wonderful sunny day!
